name: ʿIzz al-Dīn al-Zanjānī
known: ʿIzz al-Dīn Abū al-Maʿālī ʿAbd al-Wahhāb ibn Ibrāhīm
summary: Author of al-Taṣrīf, known after him as al-ʿIzzī: a short classical primer of ṣarf read in the Ottoman lands and at al-Azhar.
bio: Little is told of al-Zanjānī's life beyond his name and his death in 655/1257. His fame rests on one short book of ṣarf, which became a standard first text for the patterns of the verb and their meanings.
